reason: Free listing is fine, I'd take that if they load the flyers for me, but I'm not paying a monthly fee. My Friday and Saturday crowd comes from Instagram and word of mouth, and I don't have time to manage another platform.
objection: Another platform to look after and another monthly fee on thin margins. Nothing says an app with 2,000 users in my city will bring one extra person through my door.
would_change_my_mind: Proof, from a venue like mine, that the paid push brought in more paying customers than it cost, with no work from me.
